name: Spiral
summary: One line through points stepped by a slowly drifting angle; morphs between arms, rosettes and stars.
credit: After the spirals in Sonia Boller's audible-visuals (https://github.com/soniaboller/audible-visuals, Apache License 2.0). The idea only; no code ported.
hint: One line through points stepped round by an angle; as the step drifts, the figure passes through arms, rosettes and stars. The waveform pushes the points in and out; beats and drops kick it, it sways once a bar, and each section of the song glides to a figure of its own.

params.label: Reacts
params.help: Beats and drops kick the displacement; energy speeds the drift.

params.label: Sections
params.help: How far each section of the song moves the angle step (up to 12 degrees): a section that comes back finds its figure again.

params.label: Bar sway
params.help: How far the figure turns to and fro once a bar, as much as the beat is sure.
